svg.text: Current implementation: stereo_pose_unified_c_v1 | 17.945 M parameters | ConvNeXtV2 Nano backbone
Notation: N = 2BT; feature maps = [N, C, H, W]. B: batch, T: time, 2: left/right. Train T=8; streaming T=1.
(a) Shared visual localization and per-camera calibration
ConvNeXtV2 Nano: one shared backbone for both views
Heatmaps: [N,5,90,160] for C, H1, H2, J1, J2
k = [fx/W, fy/H, cx/W, cy/H, k1, k2, p1, p2, k3]
Known per-eye imaging parameters; no stereo baseline input.
Ports below reuse these tensors; the original RGB bypasses the backbone for local crops.
Shared weights across eyes; separate L/R histories
Predicted foreground crop from raw RGB
Detach mask and ROI coordinates; mask RGB before sampling
ROI uses C + hinge + both tips
Own parameters; shared across L/R, separate L/R histories
FC 512 -> 256 -> 2; sigmoid into physical joint limits
Predicted foreground crop from raw RGB
Detach mask and ROI coordinates; mask RGB before sampling
Own parameters; shared across L/R, separate L/R histories
FC 512 -> 256 -> 1; sigmoid into physical joint limits
(e) Pose output and deterministic articulated geometry
+ wrist pitch(1) + wrist yaw(1) + jaw half-angle(1)
Quaternion order: xyzw; C: mm; joint angles: radians.
Derive d, H1/H2, J1/J2, T and three local XYZ frames
Project each eye with its own K,D -> arrows and panels
Three independent temporal modules; state pack [3,2B,256] = [shaft, wrist, jaw]. No future frames are used.
R = original RGB; F = FPN features; M = mask logits; U = predicted landmark pixels. Dashed route = reused C token.
Tensor dimensions checked at B=1, T=1; the architecture supports causal streaming with three independent states.
